question: Can the PostFilter remove an ALREADY ACCEPTED gold relation? This is a different question from every linguistic factor tested so far: not what the generator cannot extract, but whether a deterministic downstream stage drops correct extractions.

hypothesis.H-PF-DROP: PostFilter removes a substantial share of validator-ACCEPTed gold relations.
hypothesis.H0: PostFilter passes validator-ACCEPTed gold relations unchanged.

design.material: REPLAY of the frozen assertion-isolation material (79 items, df4098c). No new sentences, no new extractor calls, no new validator calls.
design.control_set: the 22 NEGATIVE_DENY validator-REJECT items (PostFilter must not be the reason they are absent; they never reach PostFilter in production)
design.scope: PostFilter v1.1 exactly as shipped (scope gate, argument grounding, entity gate, trigger gate incl. DIRECT_SUPPORT licensing). NLI stays shadow and is NOT part of this test.
design.linker_input: global normalized pool built from the frozen gold triples of the material (probe material has no document_id); documented as an approximation of the production document-scoped pool
design.determinism: no model call; verdict is a pure function of sentence + spans + pool

primary_metric: postfilter pass rate on validator-ACCEPT gold items, with drop reason breakdown (SCOPE / ARGUMENT_GROUNDING / ENTITY / TRIGGER)

decision_rule.pf_support: PostFilter drops a material share of validator-ACCEPTed gold relations with a reproducible reason pattern
decision_rule.negative_result: PostFilter passes them; the 15/15 vs 6/24 split is then located entirely inside the validator, not downstream

forbidden: no re-labelling of the frozen material
note: Batch 7 remains the external reality check and is NOT run before this isolation.

results.material_defect_found: 8 of the 79 frozen assertion-probe items carry a NULL gold recipient (recipient-probe R1 condition); the validator was asked '... to None' for those. All 8 are validator-REJECT and never reach PostFilter in production. Excluded from this replay and listed in results.excluded_null_recipient. The assertion-probe recipient figure (6/24) is affected by this: without the NULL items it is 6/16, and the NULL items were never valid validator inputs.
results.verdict: H-PF-DROP NOT supported. The PostFilter removes 0 of 28 validator-ACCEPTed gold relations by hard REJECT. 10 move to WARN_ACCEPT (UNKNOWN_TRIGGER: review queue per the frozen WARN policy, never auto-escalated) and 3 to ABSTAIN via the entity gate (linker ambiguity). Under the shipped policy neither WARN nor ABSTAIN equals a dropped edge.
results.localization: The 15/15 vs 6/24 validator split is located inside the validator stage, not downstream. Downstream behaviour is stable and item-independent.
results.negative_control: NEGATIVE_DENY 22 items: 18 WARN_ACCEPT, 4 ABSTAIN, 0 ACCEPT - the PostFilter manufactures no edges.
